verdict.rationale: Airbyte has its own background automation: each connection can be set to Scheduled, Cron or Manual, and cron syncs run unattended on a user-defined expression. Email or webhook notifications and dbt Cloud transformations that run right after syncs extend this into a chained, monitored pipeline. However, the automation is limited to data-sync jobs; nothing shows general-purpose or agent-driven autonomous automations, and the AI features are limited to connector setup and MCP data access. Missing for 10: autonomous automation beyond scheduled sync pipelines, agent-initiated or AI-driven background tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended scheduled runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: For each connection, you can select between three options that allow a sync to run. The three options for `Schedule Type` are: Scheduled, Cron, Manual
Runs the syncs based on the user-defined cron expression
By using the dbt Cloud integration, you can create and run dbt transformations immediately following syncs in Airbyte Cloud.
Airbyte can send notifications to an email address, webhook, or both.
